tasks.label: Publish SBI PAY to GitHub
args: git init && git branch -M main && git remote remove origin 2>nul && git remote add origin https://github.com/nurkhanb776-hue/SBI-PAY.git && git add -A && git commit -m "Publish SBI PAY project" && git push -u origin main

tasks.label: Push SBI PAY main branch
args: git add -A && git commit -m Publish-SBI-PAY-project && git push -u origin main

tasks.label: Configure author and push SBI PAY
args: git config user.name nurkhanb776-hue && git config user.email nurkhanb776-hue@users.noreply.github.com && git add -A && git commit -m Publish-SBI-PAY-project && git push -u origin main

tasks.label: Verify GitHub push
args: git remote -v && git status --short --branch && git log -1 --oneline

tasks.label: Trim dependencies and push
args: git rm -r --cached --ignore-unmatch node_modules && git add -A && git commit -m Trim-dependencies-for-publish && git push --force -u origin main

tasks.label: Verify final GitHub state
args: git status --short --branch && git remote -v && git log -2 --oneline && git ls-remote --heads origin main

tasks.label: Validate SBI PAY auth and Mongo config
args: const http=require('http'); const request=(path,options={})=>new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const req=http.request({hostname:'localhost',port:10000,path,...options},res=>{let data='';res.on('data',chunk=>data+=chunk);res.on('end',()=>resolve({status:res.statusCode,body:data}))});req.on('error',reject);if(options.body)req.write(options.body);req.end()});(async()=>{const health=await request('/api/health');console.log('health',health.status,health.body);const body=JSON.stringify({phone:'8837022561',password:'Riya12340'});const login=await request('/api/login',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','Content-Length':Buffer.byteLength(body)},body});console.log('login',login.status,JSON.parse(login.body).user?.username||JSON.parse(login.body).error);})().catch(error=>{console.error(error.message);process.exit(1)})

tasks.label: Check auth endpoints
args: curl.exe -sS http://localhost:10000/api/health && echo. && curl.exe -sS -X POST http://localhost:10000/api/login -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"phone\":\"8837022561\",\"password\":\"Riya12340\"}"

tasks.label: Verify Mongo fallback and auth
args: curl.exe -sS http://localhost:10001/api/health && echo. && curl.exe -sS -X POST http://localhost:10001/api/login -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary "{\"phone\":\"8837022561\",\"password\":\"Riya12340\"}" && echo. && curl.exe -sS -X POST http://localhost:10001/api/register -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary "{\"username\":\"preflight_check_user\",\"phone\":\"9998887776\",\"password\":\"Test1234\",\"preflight\":true}"

tasks.label: Commit and push auth fixes
args: git add -A && git commit -m Fix-auth-and-mongodb-config && git push origin main
